name: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB
note: Modeled as the 600 W Workstation edition. The Max-Q edition has the same 96 GB at 300 W and ~13% lower TFLOPS. Native FP4.

name: RTX 3090 24 GB (used)
note: Ampere has no FP8 or FP4 kernels: FP8 quants run weight-only and slower. Only card here with an NVLink bridge. Back-side VRAM runs hot.

name: RTX 4090 24 GB
note: FP8 yes, FP4 no. No NVLink. The 3–4 slot cooler means two cards on one board usually need risers.

name: RTX 5090 32 GB
note: Native FP4. 575 W goes through one 12V-2x6 connector, which has melting reports. NVIDIA recommends a 1000 W PSU.

name: NVIDIA DGX Spark 128 GB
note: The GB10 CPU is ARM (aarch64): some wheels and containers are x86-only. The 128 GB is shared with the OS. A 200 GbE port links two Sparks.

name: Mac Studio M3 Ultra 512 GB
note: TFLOPS and power are estimates. macOS caps GPU memory at ~75% of RAM by default; the 512 GB fit assumes it was raised with sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb. No CUDA: runs MLX or llama.cpp, not CUDA serving stacks.

name: Mac Studio M5 Ultra 512 GB
note: TFLOPS and power are estimates. macOS caps GPU memory at ~75% of RAM by default (raise with sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb). No CUDA. M5 GPU cores add neural accelerators.

name: NVIDIA H100 PCIe 80 GB (Hopper)
note: Passive heatsink: needs server-chassis airflow, won't cool in a desktop tower. FP8 yes, FP4 no.

name: NVIDIA H100 NVL 94 GB (Hopper)
note: Passive heatsink: needs server-chassis airflow. FP8 yes, FP4 no. An NVLink bridge links 2 or 4 cards.

name: NVIDIA H200 141 GB (Hopper)
note: 700 W is the SXM module, sold only on 4- or 8-GPU HGX boards. The PCIe part is the H200 NVL at 600 W. FP8 yes, FP4 no.

name: NVIDIA B200 180 GB (Blackwell)
note: SXM only, sold in 8-GPU HGX systems: the per-card price is a share of a whole system. Native FP4.

name: NVIDIA B300 288 GB (Blackwell Ultra)
note: SXM only, sold in 8-GPU HGX systems: the per-card price is a share of a whole system. Native FP4.
